Foothills Asset Management Ltd decreased its stake in Fiserv Inc. (FISV) by 15.18% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Foothills Asset Management Ltd sold 3,428 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.86% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 19,156 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.51M, down from 22,584 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Foothills Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Fiserv Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $29.88B market cap company. The stock increased 0.66% or $0.48 during the last trading session, reaching $72.98. About 1.05 million shares traded. Fiserv, Inc. (NASDAQ:FISV) has risen 21.71% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.16% the S&P500.
